name: Wanta
notes: Recorded as adjacent: Wanta is a general agent host whose local tools are files, shell, skills, knowledge and SaaS connectors (OpenConnector), and its only graphical executor is the integrated browser. The Electron main process owns a WebContentsView per task page, Playwright attaches through a custom CDP transport over webContents.debugger, and an authenticated loopback bridge serves seven OpenCode tools: browser_navigate, browser_read (title, URL, dialog state and a Playwright AI-mode ARIA snapshot with refs), browser_click and browser_type on refs or unique selectors, browser_scroll, browser_screenshot and browser_dialog. The user shares the page and completes logins and CAPTCHAs; in Default Access the agent is told to hand sensitive actions to the user, which the design document calls a behavioural policy rather than a system guarantee. External agents keep their own accounts; hosted models, connectors and team workspaces need an OOMOL account. Packages for macOS, Windows and Linux. Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Not a fork, not archived. Code was read, not run.
summary: Electron desktop host for work agents (built-in OpenCode agent plus Claude Code, Codex and Grok adapters) whose bundled integrated browser lets agent and user operate one visible page through ARIA-snapshot refs.
